title: Ghosts'n Goblins Dreamport in C
author: NahuelGenchi
about: The cave's shooters and the axe, and the cave on to its boss: enemies that wait unseen and come out when Arthur reaches them, a weapon thrown from the top of a screen, and the axe's block test on the screen above. The interrupt that runs two frames ahead now keeps its guess of the A buttons, so the time is put right exactly. Arthur goes through the third stage's cave to $0D00, just short of its boss, exact against the original. Refs #992.
